basic_info.description: Just steps from the boutiques on Sacramento Street and a short stroll to Alta Plaza Park and the shops and dining along Upper Fillmore, this location is truly unbeatable.  This rarely found vacant duplex can be sold as a building or as individual units.  Each full floor updated flat offers two bedrooms, two bathrooms, side-by-side parking and storage.  The building benefits from an amazing walkout garden and bonus room behind the garage.  Perfect for both owner-occupants or investors seeking an exceptional opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
